description: Implement, integrate, debug, and self-check bounded source changes.
exit_contract: bounded patch, current evidence, and independent-review handoff

invalidate_on: source evidence becomes stale or fails verification

gates: select only atomic steps whose trigger matches and prerequisites are current
preserve candidate permission identity and mutation scope exactly
remote, local-system, external-session, and local-git steps remain disabled without fresh current authorization
hard dependencies are current-run prerequisites; optional dependencies never force activation; feedback dependencies feed a future pass and never block current-run execution
no passed handoff without complete four-part evidence contract
human_checkpoint: human authorizes exact workspace, writer, mutation scope, and accepted remediation

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Freeze one authorized change boundary, affected artifacts, non-goals, invariants, owners, and invalidation conditions before implementation begins.
hard_gates: No implementation begins until the required behavior, authorized workspace, single writer, allowed mutation boundary, tests, invariants, and non-goals are explicit.
Independent review, QA, audit, acquisition, analysis, and triage never imply remediation; setup or authentication never implies downstream action authority.
inputs: Authorized scope, protected paths, change identity, and expiry condition.

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Assess a codebase's maintainability, complexity, duplication, dependency, error-handling, and test-health risks from supplied source without editing it.
hard_gates: A code-health finding needs a cited source location and plausible maintenance consequence; stylistic dislike, hypothetical reuse, and aggregate scores alone do not justify remediation.
Independent review, QA, audit, acquisition, analysis, and triage never imply remediation; setup or authentication never implies downstream action authority.
inputs: Repository, time window, quality signals, ownership, and exclusions.
outputs: per-category status table from tool exits (composite score only when weights are supplied)

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Apply the smallest authorized source repair for a confirmed root cause and verify the changed behavior plus relevant regressions in one isolated workspace.
hard_gates: Remediation cannot start from an unconfirmed symptom, and it cannot pass without a root-cause-linked patch plus current focused and affected-regression evidence.
Independent review, QA, audit, acquisition, analysis, and triage never imply remediation; setup or authentication never implies downstream action authority.
inputs: Confirmed finding, reproduction evidence, source workspace, repair authority, and regression contract.

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Self-review one completed authorized change, fix only deterministic defects within its frozen scope, and leave independent review ownership intact.
hard_gates: A developer correction pass may fix deterministic in-scope defects but must never impersonate independent review, erase failed evidence, or expand the frozen change.
Independent review, QA, audit, acquisition, analysis, and triage never imply remediation; setup or authentication never implies downstream action authority.
inputs: Implemented code, its task specification, test output, and change list.
outputs: report state (DONE, DONE_WITH_CONCERNS, BLOCKED, NEEDS_CONTEXT) with concerns listed

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Author and validate a repository-scoped guard policy that intercepts declared destructive Git command patterns before execution without installing it silently.
hard_gates: Guard authoring may create tested repository artifacts but cannot modify Git config, hook paths, aliases, shell startup, or enable interception without separate local-system authorization.
Independent review, QA, audit, acquisition, analysis, and triage never imply remediation; setup or authentication never implies downstream action authority.
inputs: A command hook environment, dangerous-command policy, and local configuration.
outputs: default destructive-pattern table with near-miss pass cases

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Implement one frozen task in one isolated authorized workspace with a single writer, bounded checks, and a reviewable handoff.
hard_gates: One task has one writer and one isolated workspace; missing isolation, dirty-state ambiguity, concurrent ownership, or scope expansion blocks implementation.
Independent review, QA, audit, acquisition, analysis, and triage never imply remediation; setup or authentication never implies downstream action authority.
inputs: One approved task, complete task-local context, isolated workspace, edit scope, test command, and escalation boundary.

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Integrate an approved local base ref into an isolated change branch while preserving a recoverable pre-integration ref and performing no remote writes.
hard_gates: Local integration requires an approved local base ref, clean isolated change branch, recoverable pre-integration identity, and zero fetch, push, force, remote merge, or branch deletion.
Independent review, QA, audit, acquisition, analysis, and triage never imply remediation; setup or authentication never implies downstream action authority.
inputs: Isolated worktree, change branch, approved base reference, clean-state evidence, and local mutation authority.
outputs: integrated local branch or conflict state

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Advance an approved implementation plan through explicit step states, dependencies, checkpoints, evidence, invalidation, pause, and resume without absorbing specialist work.
hard_gates: A controller may transition only steps whose dependencies, identity, authority, and gates are current; it cannot mark specialist work passed or reuse evidence after upstream invalidation.
Independent review, QA, audit, acquisition, analysis, and triage never imply remediation; setup or authentication never implies downstream action authority.
inputs: An executable implementation plan and an isolated work environment.

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Reproduce and trace an observed defect to the highest shared evidence-backed cause without editing product source.
hard_gates: Investigation cannot declare root cause from correlation, the last stack frame, or one patched symptom; it needs a reproducible causal chain and sibling-path analysis.
Independent review, QA, audit, acquisition, analysis, and triage never imply remediation; setup or authentication never implies downstream action authority.
inputs: A test failure, production incident, unexpected behavior, build issue, or performance problem.

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Implement one authorized behavior change through a preserved RED, minimal GREEN, refactor, and current host-verification loop.
hard_gates: No TDD completion without a target-bound failing test observed before the production change, a minimal passing patch, and fresh post-change focused plus affected-regression evidence.
Independent review, QA, audit, acquisition, analysis, and triage never imply remediation; setup or authentication never implies downstream action authority.
inputs: A feature, defect, refactor, or other behavior change.

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Apply only accepted evidence-backed UI findings to authorized source and recapture the affected states without performing independent review.
hard_gates: UI remediation requires accepted reproducible findings and separate authorization; the remediator cannot create its own findings, waive risk, judge its recaptures, or issue release disposition.
Independent review, QA, audit, acquisition, analysis, and triage never imply remediation; setup or authentication never implies downstream action authority.
inputs: UI findings, source workspace, design system, platform variant, and write authority.

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Apply explicitly accepted website audit findings to authorized source, verify affected checks, and preserve a separate reassessment boundary.
hard_gates: Website remediation cannot begin without accepted audit findings and cannot close them without separate current reassessment; repair authority never includes deployment.
Independent review, QA, audit, acquisition, analysis, and triage never imply remediation; setup or authentication never implies downstream action authority.
inputs: Confirmed audit finding, source mapping, approved repair scope, workspace, and local verification command.
